experience: Clear, solvable deduction in an asynchronous prepared table read. Motive supplied character texture; Opportunity narrowed the field; Method reduced it to one suspect. As a practical skeptic I appreciated explicit records more than repeated group-flavored questions.
fun_reason: The grievance writing gave personality and a satisfying initial change of suspicion. The final elimination is clean but highly mechanical once all three constraints arrive.

navigation.assessment: Round titles, answer boxes and STOP lines make stages easy to locate. Answer then choose another guest is explicit. Two question pages per round increase scanning.
navigation.exact_quote: Choose by name / Everyone answers once / Turn only within this round
navigation.untested: No physical flipping, tear-out handling, live host tracking, waiting duration, or table noise was tested.

question_matching.assessment: My name appears in the Barb Dwyer / Paige Turner / Faye Stop group in all three rounds. Canonical questions matched the printed fields and no answer failed to address its question.
question_matching.minor_wording: Opportunity calls my situation private donor arrangements, which is broader than an embargoed journalistic story, but the question still requests the correct facts.

repetition.assessment: Motive questions differ meaningfully by grievance; Opportunity and Method are essentially the same question rewritten ten ways. Answers repeat identical inventory phrasing and preparation-record fields. This helps reliable comparison but makes sixteen-person reading feel like paperwork.
repetition.exact_quote: That was what the materials desk issued me.
repetition.change: For Opportunity and Method print one shared question and an alphabetical present-guest roster; keep colorful errand wording in each answer.

sixteen_present_vs_thirty_listed.assessment: Fourteen absent names create unnecessary search work across both question pages. Ignore absent guests is sufficient to proceed but does not tell me at a glance who remains unanswered.
sixteen_present_vs_thirty_listed.change: Supply an attendance roster with round checkboxes or mark absent names before play. Keep the full packet reusable.

note_space.observed_page_07: Opportunity has three ruled lines below Notes from this round. Visually clean but insufficient for sixteen salon times plus key yes/no and later cross-comparison.
note_space.observed_page_10: Method fills nearly the whole page with both branches and follow-up instructions; no dedicated note area is visible.
note_space.change: Add one separate deduction grid with sixteen attending-name rows and columns for salon, key, linen and motive. Do not require copying the exact key-loan minute unless it matters.

memory_load.assessment: Sixteen names and three facts each are manageable with a grid but awkward with three lines. The Method preparation record repeats access facts, allowing recovery without perfect recall.
memory_load.limits: Text was available for rereading. Human memory of the animal, retention across timed rounds and physical note-taking were not tested.

branch_safety.assessment: PIG versus HIPPO clearly made me innocent. The instruction Keep its label private is clear. Opportunity branches are identical; Method differs in the material. Both branches are visible together in the supplied file and the inspected PNG, so a player can see the alternate inventory without turning ahead.
branch_safety.actual_disclosure: I saw my own alternate murderer answer naming white linen with a gold seam while reading the Method page. No other player's private branch, selected animal identity mapping, confession or ending was shown. The public record itself was enough to select Elon.
branch_safety.hypothetical_risk: Reading the wrong labeled box or showing a neighbor the page could expose an alternate branch; this was not observed at a live table.
branch_safety.change: Use a fold-over cover or separate labeled answer inserts if concealing alternate branches is a design requirement; otherwise explicitly permit seeing both while requiring only the matching branch aloud.

roleplay.assessment: Paige's source-protection stakes are clear and do not force improvisation. I did not reveal a source name because none was supplied. The transcript provided my required answer and next question, so I did not test spontaneous conversation.
roleplay.exact_quote: Acting is optional; these printed facts are enough.
roleplay.change: Keep acting optional. Let participants embellish tone, with a short reminder to preserve the factual answer.

actual: Host publicly announced HIPPO twice, without identifying its holder.
My public answers disclosed threatened source exposure, 6:45 salon access, cabinet key borrowing and blue paper wipes.
My own Method page exposed my alternate branch inventory visually.
Method supplied explicit preparation records for every attending player, including Elon's three matching facts.

concrete_changes.change: Add attendance-specific deduction grid with salon-window, key and linen columns.
concrete_changes.why: Reduces copying and permits sixteen-player comparison in the small note space.

concrete_changes.change: Compress the ten repetitive Opportunity and Method question variants to one shared question plus guest roster.
concrete_changes.why: The information request is identical despite flavor changes.

concrete_changes.change: Retain prominent stage titles and STOP lines; make branch concealment an explicit choice with a fold-over or separate inserts if needed.
concrete_changes.why: Navigation is good, but both Method branches are plainly visible on one page.

evaluation_scope: Only player-12 supplied identity, staged text files, and packet-page-07/10 PNGs at original detail after ballot. No adjudicator, other player files, repository, web or ending inspected.
